items.title: Establish an isolated Cloudflare staging origin, then promote the same attested static artifact to production with delivered security headers
items.why: The checked-in header policy is inert on GitHub Pages, all six live headers are absent, and local-only staging cannot satisfy the stable-origin gate.
evidence: npm run verify:web-live -- --url https://promogrind.bet returned rootStatus 200 with CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, X-Frame-Options, and Permissions-Policy all absent.
Cloudflare Pages Direct Upload supports branch deployments and applies static _headers; global Wrangler 4.80.0 is already installed, avoiding a dependency change.

L1.recipe: Build once, direct-upload a staging branch, verify status/headers/standard files, and retain GitHub Pages as rollback.

L2.recipe: Add a secrets-gateway deployment wrapper, deterministic artifact/commit receipt, stable staging project/domain, Cloudflare production promotion, header and SPA-route verification, and documented forward rollback.

L3.recipe: Add staging/production parity compilation, custom-domain health, GitHub workflow promotion, immutable artifact reuse, and automatic post-deploy receipt ingestion without exposing provider credentials.

items.title: Compose existing management and target-admin authorities into a fail-closed PromoGrind Supabase deploy path
items.axis: AI integration / feature depth / security / organization
items.why: The generic management credential and exact target admin URL are both ready, but the absent synthetic capability alias prevents the pinned migration and five provider functions from deploying.
evidence: check-launch-capabilities authorized fjnpzjjyhnpmunfoycrp through its REST surface.
check-secrets reports supabase.management and supabase.admin READY while promogrind.supabase.deploy is undeclared/missing.
deploy-supabase.mjs already pins every command to fjnpzjjyhnpmunfoycrp but resolves only the absent alias.

L1.recipe: Allow an explicitly checked management-token plus target-admin URL fallback and preserve the pinned project-ref refusal.

L2.recipe: Add a target-authorization preflight against the Supabase management API, focused adversarial tests, deploy the pending migration and five AI functions, and emit redacted content-addressed receipts.

L3.recipe: Also verify remote migration/function inventories after apply and bind launch-proof completion to exact remote receipts rather than command exit alone.

items.title: Execute every machine-verifiable production proof and bind each result to the live target
items.why: Stripe, capture, auth, deployment, and production smoke authorities are available or probeable, but stale pending rows still block promotion.
evidence: Live Stripe, target Supabase, Brevo domain, and production capture configuration probes are authorized.
LAUNCH_PROOFS still has empty receipts for auth email, Stripe lifecycle, capture submission/lead observation, and provider deployment.
The launch workflow already emits post-deploy artifacts but the local launch-status aggregate exceeded the audit's 120-second probe window, so final execution needs the full bounded gate.

L1.recipe: Run live web, production dashboard, capture, and proof-list runners; record only verified redacted results.

L2.recipe: Complete disposable production auth lifecycle, capture submission plus lead-row observation, Stripe lifecycle where a safe bounded payment path exists, and ingest fresh GitHub deployment evidence.

L3.recipe: Add idempotent cleanup, receipt quorum, target/commit binding, and automatic contradiction detection between remote state and the canonical ledger.

items.title: Preflight and precisely classify the remaining human-only launch evidence without phantom blockers
items.why: Zoho alias administration, live Obelisk relying-party enrollment, historical credential rotation, and an independent friend tester must each be tried through available admin paths before any owner-only classification.
evidence: zoho.mail.admin and Obelisk relying-party declarations are missing while generic Obelisk runtime access exists.
Five historical findings are redacted and current-tree clean, but provider rotation/revocation and an approved history strategy are unproved.
No repository or agent-run smoke can truthfully substitute for independent friend-facing feedback.

L1.recipe: Run secrets discovery and elevated/admin probes for each boundary; classify exact remaining authority.

L2.recipe: Execute every available admin path, record founder deploy authorization from this session, ship any Studio-owned capability gaps through signed Ark, and retain only hardware/signup/billing/independent-tester boundaries as human-blocked.

L3.recipe: Add durable evidence contracts and expiry/renewal checks for mailbox identity, Obelisk delegation, rotation receipts, tester completion, and founder approval.
